title: PSQ Holdings Named Exclusive Payments and Consumer Credit Provider for Rayon AI's Cutting-Edge Second-Amendment Enablement Platform
summary: Agreement embeds PSQ Payments and Credova consumer financing across the operations and e-commerce software serving America's firearm manufacturers, dealers, and retailers PSQ Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: PSQH) ("PSQ Holdings"), a payments and financial infrastructure company delivering modern financial infrastructure to industries underserved by traditional banking institutions, today announced an exclusive agreement with Rayon AI, a veteran-founded software company building modern operations and commerce software for the American firearms industry. Under the agreement, PSQ Payments becomes the exclusive payment processor and Credova the exclusive consumer credit provider across Rayon's 2A-focused platform, including its direct-to-consumer storefront product. The agreement puts both of PSQ Holding’s core products, merchant processing and point-of-sale consumer financing, into the system that Rayon's merchant customers use to run their businesses.
